title: KaLoData Scraper Input
description: Scrapes product analytics from KaLoData.com using session cookie authentication.

targetUrl.title: Target URL
targetUrl.description: Direct KaLoData product URL to scrape (e.g. https://www.kalodata.com/product/12345). If provided, the actor scrapes this single product page.

keyword.title: Search Keyword
keyword.description: Search keyword to find products on KaLoData (e.g. 'water bottle'). The actor will navigate to the search results and scrape product cards.

sessionCookie.title: Session Cookie
sessionCookie.description: KaLoData session cookie value for authentication. Log in to kalodata.com in your browser, copy the 'sessionid' cookie value from DevTools > Application > Cookies.

maxProducts.title: Max Products
maxProducts.description: Maximum number of products to scrape from search results.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy configuration. Residential proxies recommended for KaLoData.
